youtube.title: How high can you go before you die?
youtube.description:
A lawn chair, a few dozen balloons and a one-way trip to the edge of space. 🎈
Past Everest's death zone, a jet at cruising altitude, and then the Armstrong limit, where your spit boils at body temperature.
Where would you turn back? Comment A, B or C 👇

Sources: NASA / Armstrong limit (water boils at 37 °C around 19 km) · FAA (time of useful consciousness at cruising altitude) · Guinness World Records (highest freefall jump, 41.4 km)
